title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail with a trailing ribbon of glowing mantle, she glides in slow figure-eights through a tank of sea-glass teal water, pausing now and then to hum a faint bubble-tune to the sleepy anemones. Her home is a moonlit garden of tilted teacups, lantern-bright kelp and a single cracked music box, which she circles each evening as if it were still playing.
